historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case product-sales growth, average of years 1-3 (13/11/10%), anchored to the H1 FY2026 +14.3% product-sales run-rate; collaboration revenue is excluded from the proxy because it is lumpy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 3yr CAGR 28.3% is 77% above the equity 3yr CAGR of 16.0%: FY2022 was a trough (collaboration revenue 84m, generics VBP cuts) and FY2025 carried RMB2.1bn of licensing income plus RMB1.1bn of interest on a growing cash pile, so trailing EPS growth overstates the underlying product-sales trend (17% revenue CAGR).
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - bank interest income): FY2020 790.6, FY2022 1,960.9, FY2025 5,024.7. Owner and reported CAGRs are within 1pp of each other because SBC is ~1% of revenue and interest income scaled with cash; the FY2025 endpoint is inflated by the RMB1.16bn deferred-revenue inflow, so neither FCF CAGR is a usable forward growth proxy.

scenario_narratives.base: Product sales keep compounding low-double-digit then fade to GDP-like growth as Ameile's indication expansion, XINYUE (gMG, IgG4-RD), Fulaimei and the PEGylated franchise offset NRDL renewal price cuts and generics erosion; R&D stays ~22-23% of revenue. Licensing is modelled as a normalised mid-cycle stream (RMB2.7-3.7bn/yr) after the FY2026 upfront spike, i.e. a fraction of headline milestones. Pre-SBC EBITDA settles at 40-41%, cash tax drifts from 18% to 20%, and the RMB33bn cash pile plus the FVTPL stakes are added once in the bridge.
scenario_narratives.bull: The pivot to a global ADC/incretin licensor works: GSK's HS-20093 wins in SCLC, Regeneron takes HS-20094 to market, the Roche portfolio generates recurring milestones, and royalties turn collaboration into a compounding stream (RMB7.7bn by FY2035). Product sales grow mid-teens near term on new indications and ex-China aumolertinib, margins expand to 45% on operating leverage, and the terminal multiple is 20x.
scenario_narratives.bear: NRDL negotiations cut prices 20-30% per renewal on the big three products while fourth-generation EGFR-TKIs and ADC competitors take share; product growth slows to low single digits by FY2029. Partnered programmes disappoint or are slowed by US-China biotech scrutiny, licensing falls to ~RMB1.5bn/yr, R&D intensity cannot be cut without hollowing the pipeline, so EBITDA margin compresses to 34%; HNTE status lapses on some subsidiaries (22% tax) and the exit multiple is 15x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the operating business on normalised owner FCF -- product sales built from the innovative-medicine franchise, licensing revenue mid-cycled rather than extrapolated from a record deal year -- and add the balance sheet once: RMB37.4bn of cash and deposits net of the RMB4.1bn convertible and the unpaid final dividend, plus the biotech investment portfolio at book. Bank interest and investment income are stripped from the flows so the cash is not counted twice. SBC is expensed and the count held flat; the convertible is debt, not shares, while it is 80% out of the money.
key_risks_to_valuation: Collaboration revenue run-rate: the base assumes RMB2.7-3.7bn/yr after FY2026; each RMB1bn/yr of sustained licensing is worth roughly RMB1.4/share (HK$1.6) at 9% and a 20% tax rate
NRDL renewal price cuts on Ameile, Hansoh Xinfu and XINYUE -- the bear case's 34% margin and 2% terminal growth is the direct expression of this
Roche US$400m upfront closing timing: slippage into FY2027 moves ~RMB2.3bn of after-tax cash by one year (~RMB0.03/share of PV), not a value change, but it would make FY2026 look like a miss
RMB/HKD: all per-share values are converted at 1.1735; a 5% RMB depreciation lowers the HKD IV ~5%
Cash pile deployment: RMB33bn net cash is 20% of the market cap; value-destructive in-licensing or M&A at inflated biotech prices would impair the bridge value taken at face
Convertible conversion (HK$57.39) or a put/redemption in cash before 2033 changes the debt/shares split but is near value-neutral below the conversion price

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 revenue RMB15,028m = pharmaceutical product sales 12,912.7 + collaboration revenue 2,115.6 (AR FY2025 note 5). The growth path is built from the two streams separately (see assumptions.*.revenue_build) and collapsed to total-revenue growth for the engine.
inputs.share_count_basis: 6,064.15m shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (interim note 18) + 14.85m dilutive RSU effect (interim note 8) = 6,079.0m. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows. The 66.7m-share dilutive effect of the Feb-2026 convertible is NOT in the count because the bond is carried as debt (conversion price HK$57.39 vs HK$31.86 price, 80% out of the money); converting it would cut net debt by RMB4.1bn and add 81.5m shares, roughly value-neutral at today's price.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 balance sheet (interim). Cash and bank balances RMB37,382.9m includes RMB32,725.8m of >3-month time deposits (interim note 13) -- the cash-flow-statement 'cash and cash equivalents' of RMB4.66bn excludes them. Total debt = HK$4,680m zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2033 at carrying value RMB4,084.8m (debt 3,247.4 + embedded derivative 837.4; face at 1.1735 is RMB3,988m). No bank borrowings. Lease liabilities (RMB62m) excluded under lease treatment (B). Post-balance-date: the US$320m Avere/NextCure placement (July 2026) swaps ~RMB2.3bn cash for a 30-40% stake, neutral at cost and not adjusted; the Roche US$400m upfront (Oct 2026) is in FY2026 collaboration revenue, not added to cash, to avoid double-counting.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2025 OCF 6,738.2 less capex 489.5 (PP&E 356.4 + intangibles 133.0). OCF was flattered by a RMB1,162m increase in contract liabilities (deferred collaboration upfronts, 19 -> 1,181m) that unwound in H1 FY2026 (1,181 -> 94m); underlying FY2025 owner FCF ex that timing item is ~RMB3.9bn (25.7% of revenue). The component build, not this figure, sets the forward margin.
inputs.interest_income_note: Bank interest income RMB1,080.8m (AR FY2025 note 5, other income) stripped because net cash (RMB33.3bn) is >6x the FCF base; the cash pile is added once in the bridge. Investment income (17.0m FY2025; 631.1m in H1 FY2026, largely realised gains on wealth-management/VC positions) is also outside the operating flows and its source asset (FVTPL RMB1,326.9m) is in the equity bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: AR FY2025 cash-flow statement 'Share-based payments' RMB143,268k (line 4148); no equity-award tax withholding line (net-share settlement not used; RSUs funded by on-market repurchase into trust)
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 repurchases for the RSU trust were nil (FY2024 33.7m; H1 FY2026 12.7m). The flat count is a modelling convention funded by the SBC expense, not by an active buyback programme.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1735, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-22T11:37Z. Direction: per-share values computed in RMB then multiplied by 1.1735 to HKD. No dual listing exists for a parity check; cross-check on the convertible: HK$4,680m booked as RMB4,170.7m on 3 Feb 2026 = 1.1221, a 4.6% RMB appreciation since issue, consistent with USDCNY ~6.95 -> ~6.65 over the period. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate; re-derive it on any later refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB flows discounted at an RMB-built rate: China 10y CGB ~1.8% (Oct 2026) + beta 1.0 x China ERP 6.0% + 1.2pp HK-listed China regulatory/governance premium = 9.0% cost of equity. Net cash, zero-coupon convertible is the only debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Same 9% in all three scenarios: NRDL price-cut, pipeline and licensing risk are charged in the flows, not stacked on the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: lease principal (22.4m) + lease interest (2.6m) = RMB25m FY2025, 0.17% of revenue, charged via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities excluded from net debt; D&A for cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation (PP&E 351.0 + intangibles 13.3 = 364.4m, 2.4% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: None: profit is 100% attributable to owners of the parent (no minority interests on the balance sheet).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US adaptations -- Hansoh is an operating innovative-drug company whose value is a stream of product-sales and licensing cash flows, so the SKILL.md routing table sends it to owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md (RMB reporting / HKD quote, net cash, small leases, SBC-light). REVENUE IS BUILT FROM TWO STREAMS: (1) pharmaceutical product sales (RMB12,913m FY2025, +20.8%; H1 FY2026 +14.3%), ~85% innovative medicines led by Ameile/aumolertinib; (2) collaboration/licensing revenue (RMB2,116m FY2025, recognised at a point in time) which is lumpy and deal-driven. Year 1 (FY2026) carries the contracted upfronts actually in hand -- Roche ADC portfolio US$400m (Oct 2026, subject to closing), Avere HS-20118 US$120m (Jul 2026) -- and the stream is then normalised to a mid-cycle run-rate rather than extrapolated: ~RMB2.7-3.7bn/yr in the base case is what a risk-adjusted flow of milestones and early royalties on the GSK (HS-20093/HS-20089 ADCs), Regeneron (HS-20094), Roche and Glenmark programmes supports, against >US$20bn of headline milestones that will not all be earned. EBITDA margin is pre-SBC operating EBITDA EXCLUDING other income (bank interest, investment income, grants): FY2025 39.1%, FY2024 36.7%, FY2023 32.1%; year-1 47% reflects the high-margin licensing spike and fades to a 40-41% mature level. Cash tax: FY2025 effective rate on operating profit ex interest 18.2% (15% HNTE rate on key subsidiaries, R&D super-deduction, offset by PRC dividend withholding tax accrual RMB269m); ramped to 20% for HNTE renewal risk and repatriation WHT. Working capital capture negative (receivables + inventory exceed payables); the FY2025 deferred-revenue inflow is treated as timing, not run-rate. House/street band is narrow because SBC is <1% of revenue. Balance-sheet vintage: June 2026 cash is used against FY2026 full-year flows; the H1 FY2026 owner FCF already in that cash (~RMB1.3bn) is almost exactly offset by the RMB1,053m FY2025 final dividend payable deducted in the bridge, so the overlap is immaterial (<RMB0.05/share).

bear.growth_rates_note: Product sales +8/6/5/4/3/3/2/2/2/2% (NRDL renewals cut Ameile/Hansoh Xinfu/XINYUE prices 20-30% each cycle, third-gen EGFR-TKI competition, generics keep eroding); collaboration 4,000 (Roche still closes), 2,000, 1,500 then +2%/yr as partner programmes stall and US-China biotech scrutiny slows new deals. Totals 17,946 -> 20,260.

base.growth_rates_note: Product sales +13/11/10/9/8/7/6/5/4/3.5% (FY2026 14,591 -> FY2035 26,885); collaboration 4,800 (FY2026: Roche US$400m + Avere US$120m upfronts + run-rate milestones), 3,200 (FY2027, incl. Roche US$110m year-one payment), 2,700, then +5%/yr to 3,700 as GSK/Regeneron/Roche milestones and early royalties replace upfronts. Totals 19,391 / 19,396 / 20,516 / 22,269 / 23,973 / 25,591 / 27,088 / 28,427 / 29,576 / 30,585.
base.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-SBC operating EBITDA ex other income. FY2026 47% = FY2025's 39.1% lifted by ~RMB2.7bn of incremental ~100%-margin licensing revenue (H1 FY2026 actual 47.5%); normalises to 40% by FY2028 as collaboration falls back and R&D stays ~22-23% of revenue; +1pp S&D leverage by FY2033.

bull.growth_rates_note: Product sales +16/14/12/11/10/9/8/7/6/5% (new indications for Ameile and XINYUE, EU/UK aumolertinib, GLP-1/GIP China launch ~2029); collaboration 5,500, 4,000, 3,500 then +12%/yr to 7,737 as HS-20093 (GSK, SCLC) and HS-20094 (Regeneron) reach market and royalties compound. Totals 20,479 -> 40,474.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because volumes depend on a single regulator (NRDL) whose renewals have historically imposed steep price cuts, two-thirds of revenue is oncology led by one molecule, and the forward thesis increasingly rests on cross-border licensing exposed to US-China policy. Bull trimmed from 35% to 25% because it requires several independent partner programmes (GSK, Regeneron, Roche) to succeed on schedule. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_position_note: The house/street band is only ~HK$0.45/share wide because SBC is <1% of revenue, so band_position is a large number whenever the price sits outside it; read it as 'price is above the street IV', not as a regime finding. Not null because house and street do not coincide exactly.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
